Hi Marissa,

We need to request removal of a single conversation from Redwood logs as part of a regulatory review. Details below:

- Account: GreenWave Health
- Support case: SUP-77813
- Conversation identifier: thread-id: 2025-07-22-ACME-4477 (appears in our export)

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the details and the export. I've opened an internal support/deletion case (GW-SUPPORT-77813) and am routing this to our security operations team for the one-off suppression.

Quick checklist of what we need to proceed:
1) Explicit written authorization from an authorized GreenWave signatory (can be the compliance address on this thread).
2) Confirmation that the thread to remove is the export you attached (file name + checksum would be helpful).
3) Whether you want immediate removal from all telemetry and backups, or a staged approach (primary logs first, then backups).

We aim to have a deletion window within 48 hours of receiving the signed authorization, pending verification of residency and backup scope. I will coordinate with Ops and send a confirmation when the action completes, including an audit snapshot.

If helpful I can loop in Steph to validate the residency constraints (EU-only) before we run the job.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Support Manager | Redwood Inference

- Identify all storage layers containing this conversation: streaming telemetry, short-term logs (7d), retention index, and backups (snapshots).
- Provide a safe deletion plan: primary index purge, KV cache flush, then backup overwrite/segmented removal where supported. Note: we may need a snapshot of the audit record before alteration.
- Schedule deletion window: proposed 2026-11-04 02:00 UTC (low traffic). If backups require coordination with infra, escalate.

Attached: deletion-checklist.md (internal procedure)

Please reply in-thread with status and any blockers. If legal needs to review the authorization, ping me.

—Marissa
